verdict.rationale: Restate automatically persists completed steps and resumes execution from the point of failure (restate-docs-1, restate-docs-15, restate-docs-18), and introspection tools (CLI/SQL API) expose invocation history (restate-docs-10). However, there is no documented explicit 'replay from a specific step' or manual rerun/time-travel debugging feature — recovery is automatic on retry/crash rather than an operator-triggered replay from an arbitrary chosen step. missing for 10: explicit support for manually triggering a replay/rerun of a completed or failed workflow from a chosen step, UI/CLI commands for selective replay, and independent/hands-on evidence of this debugging workflow in practice.
